question: In what sense do beings and experiences of non-being shine as spaces of your light?
premises: Beings and experiences of non-being are named together.
They shine continually as spaces of light.
inference: All beings and experiences of non-being are manifestations shining within your light.
uncertainties: prakāśakāśāḥ may be read as luminous spaces or as the ether of light.
plain_english: Beings and experiences of non-being are indeed yours; as spaces of light, they always shine.
